patch_description: This design shifts the search from repeated small neighborhoods toward an adaptive mixture of guided switches, multi-switch perturbations, and repaired edge-set recombination. Recombination uses the repaired QAOA pool as a reservoir of alternate structures, while an LP-scored archive supplies stronger donors. Parent selection balances solution quality with under-exploration, and operator probabilities respond to which proposal types have recently produced improvements. LP calls are spent on a small, varied batch screened by the available surrogate rather than on a large neighborhood.
